description: Lists one operator's wellbore claims from the publication, filtered by outcome (AFFECTED, APPROACHING or ALL; default AFFECTED) and sorted by Commission-published plugging cost descending, unpriced wellbores last, then by API number. Returns one page of at most 100 rows plus the number matching and the Commission-published cost total over all matching rows (the same on every page). When more rows remain, next_cursor is set: pass it back as cursor, with the same operator_number and outcome, for the next page. A cursor is bound to the publication root that issued it.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged. Omit for the first page. Refused when it was issued for another publication root, operator or outcome.

limit.description: Maximum rows on this page, 1-100. Default 25.

operator_number.description: Six-digit Railroad Commission of Texas operator number, with leading zeros (e.g. 276959).

outcome.description: AFFECTED: affected at the evaluation date. APPROACHING: not affected then but affected by 2042-09-01 (compliance-plan horizon). ALL: every claim. Default AFFECTED.

name: list_operator_wells

boundary.const: Screening results are cost proxies. They are not ARO, not legal determinations, not bond amounts. Production, legal and financial reliance are on HOLD.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

offset.description: Position of this page's first row in the full sorted listing, from 0.

truncated.description: True when rows remain after this page.

approaching.description: Not AFFECTED at the evaluation date, and AFFECTED on the same rule, with no other change, by 2042-09-01 (compliance-plan horizon).

title: List an operator's wellbores
